page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance tradeoff between single-threaded and multi-threaded operations. Single-core CPU performance is weak, as demonstrated by stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, alongside poor single-threaded gzip compression. However, the instance leverages its 32 physical cores to deliver average multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression all scoring in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth remains average for both small and large blocks, though Passmark memory scores are relatively weak.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.sn2.7xlarge is positioned as a cost-efficient option for workloads that benefit from parallel processing but do not require high single-thread performance. It is suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations, as reflected in its average scores for Redis SET operations and Passmark database tests. It can also handle light LLM inference tasks for smaller models, though text generation speeds remain weak to average.
